name: 45429 · Kettering, OH
findings: ZIP 45429 (Kettering) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45429 (Kettering) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
